channel.description: Recent content in Sing-Box on CX's Blog

item.title: Troubleshooting DNS Timeouts on a Bypass Router: sing-box Upstream Queries Leave Through the Wrong Network Interface
item.description: Downstream DNS requests reach sing-box, but upstream forwarding bypasses WireGuard; locate the fault with targeted packet captures and fix it with bind_interface.

item.title: IPv6 HTTPS Timeouts After Enabling sing-box auto_redirect on Armbian: Troubleshooting a Missing Loopback Address
item.description: IPv6 ping works, but HTTPS times out in sing-box auto_redirect mode. The issue is diagnosed using nftables, tcpdump, and a check of the IPv6 loopback address.

item.title: UFW 与 sing-box TUN auto_redirect 冲突：动态端口被拦截的排查
item.description: 通过 UFW 日志、nftables redirect 和 conntrack DNAT 状态，排查 Linux 旁路由透明代理动态端口被阻止的问题。
